content.comment_body: Hello, I have a basic question. I'm working on a function that activates an output when an input is pressed twice within two seconds, and then deactivates it after the same input is pressed twice again within two seconds. I’ve set up the up/down counter to track the input signals, using a flag to reset the counter, but I’m unsure how to add the timing feature. Thanks,

Hello, There’s a user who has shared many example projects, including one for double tap functionality. You can find it here: [url]. Review that example to see the approach used. If you’re still having issues, feel free to share your work so far (as a zipped file). Best regards,
Hello, Thanks for the helpful link. The double tap button is now working and my problem is solved.

Hi, Here’s something to check: B011 sets the allowable time for button presses, B010 determines how many times the button should be pressed. B012 is used for positive edge detection and B013 functions as a Pulse Relay. Hope this helps.
Many thanks to [url] for providing all those useful examples. Regards,

analysis.insight_summary: The user was initially unsure how to implement timed input detection with a counter for double-tap functionality on a logic controller. After being directed to an example, the problem was quickly resolved. Additional advice regarding timer parameters and edge detection contributed further clarity for similar projects.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks clear instructions or example code on implementing double-tap input detection, especially using timed logic with available controller hardware or programming tools.
